chronological_split.method: Trades are assigned to development / validation / out-of-sample by entry time. Rule constants were frozen in code before evaluation; the out-of-sample window was not used to tune any parameter.

cost_model.model: net = gross - cost_price * volume, applied once per closed trade
cost_model.unit: USD of P&L per unit of simulated volume; XAUUSD point = 0.01

measured_spread.note: Mean of MT5's per-bar spread field. It is a genuine measured value but a per-bar approximation, not a tick-level spread series.

cost_model.central_cost_basis: Shared central cost for every leg so the three are comparable. Measured from MT5's per-bar spread field where present, otherwise a labelled default.
cost_model.omitted_costs_note: Commission and swap are unknown and omitted from the primary figure; the sensitivity grid bounds their effect only approximately. No profitability claim is made from this sample.

trend_pullback.label: Trend-following pullback (H1 context, M15 pullback, M5 trigger)

limitations: One symbol (XAUUSD) and one regime over the requested window; results do not generalise and no strategy is declared superior from in-sample profit or a small sample.
Research trades are hypothetical simulations, not broker fills; they are distinct from live Fibonacci signals, shadow validation and backtests.
Commission and swap are unknown and not modelled; cost is per-bar spread plus a labelled assumption grid.
The Fibonacci baseline is per-timeframe and the research strategies are multi-timeframe, so the comparison is directional, not an exact match.
Higher-timeframe rules use completed bars only, which removes (never adds) signals relative to a forward-looking rule.
order_submission: Not called. No MetaTrader order-execution function is imported or invoked anywhere in the research path.
